name: TILV Yield Optimizer
description: Autonomous AI agent that optimises liquidity allocation across TILV's three-tier invoice vault system (Prime / Growth / Emerging) on Mantle Network. Reads on-chain vault state every hour, computes risk-adjusted APY differentials, and rebalances capital to maximise yield for liquidity providers. All decisions are validated on-chain before execution and outcomes are recorded as reputation feedback.
